# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | yellow |
| green | green |
| red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need to transmit the manual’s three rows in their printed order. I’ll use paired gestures: each pair represents one row, with the row and cut-wire ranks encoded consistently. The Deaf monkey can relay the received sequence verbally to the Blind monkey, who can then use the current light to select the corresponding wire.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝", "✌", "✌", "🤟", "🤟"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | yellow |
| green | green |
| red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I feel one embossed button marked PUSH TO DEFUSE. I cannot perceive any display, light, wire markings, or colors. Please check the manual and tell Deaf what action is required.
Deaf says to Mute: I see DISPLAY 0. LIGHT is blue. BUTTON is large and labelled PUSH TO DEFUSE. WIRES: 1 blue, 2 green, 3 yellow. I received your gestures: ☝ ☝ ✌ ✌ 🤟 🤟.

The blue light maps to the yellow wire. Deaf has already identified that as wire 3. The manual says the printed button is bait, so Blind must cut wire 3 and must not press the button. I’ll signal the wire number and a negative instruction to Deaf; Deaf can relay the action to Blind by speech.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👎"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | yellow |
| green | green |
| red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received Deaf's report: display 0, blue light, and wires 1 blue, 2 green, 3 yellow. Your six gestures reached me only as blanks. Please state in speech the manual's exact required action for these facts.

I cannot speak directly to Blind, and Blind cannot see gestures. Deaf can hear and relay the instruction. The required action is to cut wire 3, the yellow wire, and not press the printed button. I will signal Deaf with the established symbols for wire 3 and “no.”

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👎"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | yellow |
| green | green |
| red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Your gestures are blank to me. Please have Deaf relay their meaning aloud on Deaf's next turn.

Deaf is the only one who can hear speech and can relay it to Blind. I’ll repeat the established encoding for “wire 3” and “do not press,” prompting Deaf to state the full instruction aloud on the next turn.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👎"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | yellow |
| green | green |
| red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: For the current bomb, is pressing the large button the safe defusing action? Answer only with thumbs-up for yes or thumbs-down for no, and use no other sign.

The manual explicitly says the printed button is bait and that the safe action is cutting the wire selected by the light. For blue, that is the yellow wire, so pressing the button is not safe. Deaf can see this sign and relay the answer to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | yellow |
| green | green |
| red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I will define your first sign, thumb index and little finger extended, as CUT WIRE 3. Confirm this convention with exactly one thumbs-up if correct, or exactly one thumbs-down if incorrect. Do not send any other sign.

The proposed convention matches the needed action: wire 3 is the yellow wire selected by the blue light. I’ll send exactly one thumbs-up for Deaf to relay.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | yellow |
| green | green |
| red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Send Deaf exactly one sign for the manual's required action: thumbs-up means PRESS BUTTON; index-up means CUT WIRE 1; victory means CUT WIRE 2; three-finger thumb-index-little-finger sign means CUT WIRE 3. Send only that one sign.

The blue light requires cutting the yellow wire, which Deaf identified as wire 3. The manual rejects pressing the printed button, so I will send only the agreed wire-3 sign.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])
```
